story.title: For 15,000 years, humans and dogs have been changing each other
story.reason: A deeply heartwarming look at the 15,000-year bond between humans and dogs, highlighting mutual adaptation and companionship.
story.recommended_reason: A deeply heartwarming and uplifting look at the 15,000-year bond between humans and dogs, showcasing how companionship and mutual adaptation shaped both species across history.

concepts.title_ja: 星空の下での遥かな旅路
concepts.concept_ja: 1万5千年の絆をテーマに、黄色のダックとやさしい犬が夜空を見上げる静かで温かいイラスト。
concepts.concept_en: A peaceful and heartwarming illustration depicting the yellow duck mascot and a gentle dog gazing up at a starry night sky, symbolizing a 15,000-year journey.
concepts.composition_ja: 中央やや左に並んで座る黄色いダックと犬。背景には広大な星空と、歴史の長さを象徴するうっすらとした丘のシルエット。ローアングルからの広角構図。
concepts.composition_en: Low-angle wide shot featuring the yellow duck mascot and a friendly dog sitting side-by-side slightly left of center, looking up at a vast starry night sky over gentle rolling hills.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Clean modern editorial vector-style illustration for a news feature. A recognizable cute yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a small feather tuft on its head, and a warm friendly expression, sitting comfortably next to a happy, loyal golden dog on a grassy hill. They are both looking up at a beautiful night sky filled with soft glowing stars and a gentle crescent moon. Warm twilight color palette with navy blue, soft gold, and deep turquoise. Wide horizontal 16:9 aspect ratio suitable for web hero image. No text, no logos, no watermarks, simple and charming design.
concepts.alt_ja: 星空の下で並んで座り、夜空を見上げる黄色いダックと仲良しの犬
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot and a friendly dog sitting together under a starry night sky.

concepts.concept_ja: 明るくモダンな展示スペースで、人間と犬の長い歴史を示す足跡のレリーフを好奇心旺盛に眺めるダックと犬。
concepts.concept_en: In a bright modern editorial gallery space, the duck mascot and a friendly dog curiously examine a stone relief showing side-by-side human and canine footprints.
concepts.composition_ja: 中央に展示された美しい彫刻のストーンプレート。左側に小さな探検家風の帽子をかぶった黄色いダック、右側に笑顔の犬。アイレベルのミディアムショット。
concepts.composition_en: Eye-level medium shot centered on a stylish museum display stone plaque with embossed footprints. On the left stands the yellow duck wearing a tiny stylized explorer cap, and on the right stands a cheerful dog looking on happily.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Clean modern editorial illustration. A cute recognizable yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a small feather tuft, and a warm smiling expression, wearing a tiny stylish explorer cap. The duck stands next to a joyful brown and white dog inside a warm, softly lit modern gallery room. Between them is a stylized minimalist stone display showing carved human and dog footprints side by side. Bright, warm lighting, pastel earth tones, warm cream background. Minimalist studio layout, no text, no logos, no watermarks, clear visual hierarchy.
concepts.alt_ja: 人と犬の足跡が刻まれたプレートを笑顔で眺める黄色いダックと犬
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot wearing a small hat looking at a stone plaque of human and dog footprints alongside a cheerful dog.

concepts.title_ja: 夕暮れ公園の絆ハイタッチ
concepts.concept_ja: 夕陽の光に包まれた公園の芝生で、ダックと犬が楽しそうにハイタッチ（前脚タッチ）を交わす心温まる瞬間。
concepts.concept_en: A heartwarming close-up moment in a sunlit park during golden hour, where the duck mascot and a dog playfully high-five.
concepts.composition_ja: ピクニックシートが敷かれた芝生の上でのクロースアップ構図。画面中央でダックの羽と犬の前脚が触れ合う瞬間を捉えている。
concepts.composition_en: Close-up horizontal framing on a picnic blanket over green park grass. In the center, the yellow duck mascot warmly reaches out its wing to touch the friendly dog's front paw in a high-five gesture.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Charming and heartwarming modern vector editorial illustration. A recognizable cute yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a small feather tuft on top, and a joyful smile, sharing a gentle high-five gesture with the paw of a happy fluffy dog on a red-and-white checkered picnic blanket. Warm sunset golden hour lighting, soft background bokeh of park trees, vibrant orange, yellow, and warm green colors. 16:9 aspect ratio, clean minimalist style, no text, no watermarks, no logos.
concepts.alt_ja: 夕方の公園のピクニックシートで、楽しそうにハイタッチをする黄色いダックと犬
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot and a happy dog sharing a high-five on a picnic blanket in a sunlit park.

concepts.title_ja: 一本の道を歩むパートナー
concepts.concept_ja: 歴史の流れを象徴する一本の小道を、ダックと犬が仲良く歩んでいくパノラマ感あふれる構図。
concepts.concept_en: A panoramic side-view illustration showing the duck mascot and dog walking side-by-side along a winding path through a scenic natural landscape.
concepts.composition_ja: 左から右へ続く緩やかな小道。画面中央をダックと犬が横顔で歩いていく。背景には古くからの大自然と現代的な緑豊かな公園が調和して広がる。
concepts.composition_en: Wide side-profile shot showing a gentle winding path from left to right. The yellow duck mascot and a tail-wagging dog walk side-by-side along the path through a lush landscape blending natural stone and vibrant greenery.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Simple modern editorial horizontal illustration. A cute recognizable yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a small feather tuft, and a happy expression, walking side-by-side with a friendly dog along a winding dirt path through a bright scenic countryside landscape. Soft daylight, clear blue sky with fluffy clouds, fresh green grass, gentle hills. Panoramic 16:9 view, smooth shapes, vector style, clean aesthetic, no embedded text, no logos, no watermarks.
concepts.alt_ja: 緑豊かな小道を仲良く並んで歩く黄色いダックと犬
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot and a friendly dog walking together along a sunny countryside path.

concepts.title_ja: あたたかな部屋での憩い
concepts.concept_ja: 温かい暖炉の光が灯る部屋で、クッションの上でリラックスして寄り添うダックと犬の日常の一コマ。
concepts.concept_en: A cozy indoor scene in a warm living room where the duck mascot and a dog relax side-by-side on a rug, reflecting comfort and long-standing companionship.
concepts.composition_ja: 部屋のラグの上のダックと犬。ダックは小さなクッションによりかかり、犬はダックの隣で心地よさそうに丸くなっている。温かい照明の室内空間。
concepts.composition_en: Warm indoor medium shot. On a cozy rug, the yellow duck mascot leans happily against a small cushion next to a resting dog curled up peacefully.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: Heartwarming modern editorial vector illustration. A cute recognizable yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large dark glossy eyes, a small feather tuft on its head, and a relaxed friendly smile, resting cozy on a soft circular rug next to a sleeping companion dog. Warm indoor ambient glow, soft yellow and coral tones, clean Scandinavian-style living room background with minimal furniture. 16:9 horizontal format, charming atmosphere, no typography, no watermarks, no logos.
concepts.alt_ja: 温かいお部屋のラグの上で、気持ちよさそうに寄り添う黄色いダックと犬
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot relaxing warmly beside a sleeping dog on a cozy living room rug.

selection_rule: Reply with exactly one digit: 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
